svg.title: Competitor Product Intelligence — current local architecture
svg.desc: Browser connects to React/Vite. FastAPI persists jobs and outbox entries in PostgreSQL. Dispatcher publishes to RabbitMQ. Celery fetches the owned fixture and persists snapshots, records and evidence. UI polls the API for saved results.
svg.text: Local architecture · from product page to source evidence
Current implementation / Seven application services / Deterministic extraction / No model inference
PODMAN COMPOSE NETWORK · database and broker have no published host ports
Blue arrows: HTTP, database access, and task delivery
Green arrow: worker state, snapshots, and extraction writes
Scope: local fixture flow. Agents, rendering, evaluation, review, exports, and remote deployment are later increments.
